identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of Nimotuzumab Combinated With Gemcitabine in K-RAS Wild-type Locally Advanced and Metastatic Pancreatic Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Prospective, Randomized, Controlled, Double-blind, Multi-center Clinical Study of Nimotuzumab Combinated With Gemcitabine Contrast to Placebo Combinated With Gemcitabine in K-RAS Wild-type,Locally Advanced and Metastatic Pancreatic Cancer

armGroups.label: Nimotuzumab and Gemcitabine
armGroups.description:
nimotuzumab,400mg/w，Intravenous infusion over 60 minutes,Until disease progression or intolerable toxicity or subjects ask to leave the test.

Gemcitabine，1000mg/m2，Intravenous infusion over 30 minutes,Once every three weeks, rest one week (d1,8,15; q28d), Every 4 weeks for a period,Until disease progression or intolerable toxicity or subjects ask to leave the test.
